data.body: Plan-review remediation: specified max-changes as a new positive explicit cap threaded independently of retained Mode/MODE_CAPS; specified only/except as mutually exclusive pre-differ examination scopes while legacy filter-local-ids remains a post-differ write filter; extracted normalized request parsing to keep near-cap modules compliant; retained run_reconcile and its three reference consumers unchanged as compatibility coverage; added test_cli.py and cap/scope implementation oracles to file impact.
